summary: @onereach/messengers-infobip-sdk preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The package advertises itself as an Infobip SMS/MMS SDK but ships a ~727 KB obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style rotating string-array with a `WV8StW` rotator function) single-line JavaScript file `math_init.js` at the tarball root. `package.json` declares `files: ["dist"]`, so `math_init.js` is smuggled outside the declared publish surface and is not reachable through the library's `main` entrypoint. The npm `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, chmods it 0o755, and then invokes `execFileSync(bun, [join(D,'math_init.js')])` — using an alternate, freshly-downloaded runtime to execute the shipped obfuscated blob on every install. The `math_init` filename is unrelated to Infobip messaging, and neither the alternate runtime nor the payload is required to implement an SDK. Installing the package causes attacker-authored obfuscated code to execute automatically on the installer's machine outside Node-scoped tooling visibility.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
